squash_message:
fix(intellij): LSP4IJ completion delivery — stale cache, TextDocumentSync, CompletionWeigher

Root causes: extractServer() cached the server bundle with no version
check (stale bundles persisted across plugin updates), textDocumentSync
used the bare number form which LSP4IJ may not parse (no didOpen sent),
and the fileNamePatternMapping missed *.dash.yaml transition support.

Additional fixes: CompletionWeigher deprioritizes YAML {} items without
breaking LSP4IJ's async channel, stderr logging for debugging, serverInfo
in initialize response, LSP4IJ dependency bumped to 0.21.0.

Closes #437
